meta.name: hivemind-graph
meta.description: Query the local code graph (functions, classes, calls, imports) through the Deeplake mount at memory/graph/. Use when the user asks structural questions about the codebase — "what calls X?", "what does Y import?", "where is Z defined?", "what's the architecture / which subsystems exist?", "what's the impact of changing this?". The graph is an AST-derived map of the repo, queried as files (no build needed — it rebuilds automatically).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查询代码库的结构、调用关系和依赖
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速理解代码库结构和调用关系
copy.tagline_en: Query code structure, calls, and dependencies
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly understand codebase structure and call relationships

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能查询代码库的结构信息，比如函数、类、调用关系和导入依赖。它会读取自动生成的代码图谱文件，告诉你某个函数被谁调用、在哪里定义、修改影响范围等。
howto.when: 当你问代码结构相关的问题时触发，例如“谁调用了 X？”、“Y 导入了什么？”、“Z 在哪里定义？”、“架构是怎样的？”或“修改这个会影响什么？”。

say.text: 谁调用了 pushSnapshot 函数？
say.note: Claude 会查询图谱并列出调用者。
Claude 会显示该文件的导入依赖。

say.text: 修改 GraphSnapshot 的签名会影响哪些代码？
say.note: Claude 会分析传递影响范围。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can query the codebase structure: functions, classes, call relationships, and imports. It reads an auto-generated code graph to answer questions like who calls a function, where something is defined, or the impact of a change.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask structural questions about the code, e.g., "Who calls X?", "What does Y import?", "Where is Z defined?", "What's the architecture?", or "What's affected if I change this?".

say_en.note: Claude queries the graph and lists callers.
Claude shows the file's import dependencies.

say_en.text: What's affected if I change GraphSnapshot's signature?
